packageRules.description: Actions bumps are never automerged here. gate-verified fails any PR whose .github/workflows/tofu-plan.yml blob differs from main unless a maintainer applies the workflow-update label -- which Renovate cannot do, and which workflow_run does not re-evaluate on labeling. Such a PR blocks rather than bypasses, but it blocks permanently, so it needs a person from the start. See ADR-0007 and ADR-0001.
Provider bumps reach every repo in the org through tofu-apply. The plan output is the review.
